problem: With disk cache disabled or insufficient, completed folder preparation could discard native pixels without retaining an autonomous viewing preview. Neighbour prefetch also waited for the whole folder and treated filmstrip demand as sufficient.
changes: Folder loading derives and accounts an independent viewer mip tail before counting the photo complete, using the already developed pixels on the I/O lane. Equivalent mip geometry is aliased directly.

Retain prepared viewing previews ahead of optional native data, preferring nearby photos in visible order. Reclaim only the headroom requested by a failed admission, removing aliases together. OS memory pressure can still release optional data.

Run neighbour prefetch while bulk folder preparation continues, resolve saved RAW recipes first, and distinguish filmstrip thumbnails from viewing previews. Retain demand for pending admitted neighbours.
Temporarily blocked background admissions are deferred instead of becoming permanent photo errors. Preserve foreground errors for work that cannot fit.
Cache rebuilding uses the same two phases; pause, cancellation, recipe identity and generation invalidation remain enforced. RAM/disk quotas and pixel quality are unchanged.
Extend the opt-in native diagnostic to retain only prepared viewing previews and compare the actual displayed raster with the CPU reference.

regressions: reuse without new source reads or decode
nearby preview retention and alias eviction
prefetch while folder loads and filmstrip exists
temporary memory admission and later recovery

verification.visual_inspection: Final foreground popup and completed grid screenshots inspected; new explanatory text and controls fit, all twelve generated thumbnails present.

disabled.scope: Isolated native folder loading and cache clear during foreground/background preparation, disk deletion and fresh decoding. Fitted viewer and thumbnail preparation; not native 1:1, GPU readiness or guaranteed disk retention beyond configured quotas.

limited.scope: Isolated native folder loading and cache clear during foreground/background preparation, disk deletion and fresh decoding. Fitted viewer and thumbnail preparation; not native 1:1, GPU readiness or guaranteed disk retention beyond configured quotas.

limitations: A completed folder means its photos were processed, not that every photo remains resident. Memory and disk quotas, including reusable RAM set to zero, remain binding. Native zoom, larger views, evictions, or source/recipe/quality changes can require new work.
Functional tests on two Nikon D750 sources and generated PNG fixtures on macOS. No new Windows, other-camera, absolute colour, physical-memory or R0-R4/SF qualification.

The native retained-preview trace covers Fit selection/return in Full and Standard. It does not guarantee native zoom retention with disk disabled. Full-cache native-detail reloads are checked separately in the RAW matrix.
Surface readback matches CPU rendering within one 8-bit channel level. It is not a measurement of every physical display refresh, p95/p99 latency or a controlled before/after speedup.
Earlier interrupted-session evidence is retained privately but is not counted as a new run in this report. The counted RAW/native/XPC runs use the final delivered bundle hashes.
